basedOn: Tafhim al-Qur'an by Sayyid Abul A'la Maududi (introduction)

sections.title: Where and when it was revealed
paragraphs: In Makkah, and scholars agree. Maududi thinks it came when Abu Lahab's hostility had become extreme, perhaps during the boycott, when he was the only one of the Prophet's ﷺ clan who sided with the enemies against his own family.

sections.title: Who was Abu Lahab?
paragraphs: He was the Prophet's ﷺ own uncle. In Arabia, an uncle was like a father, and families always protected their relatives. Even relatives who did not believe protected the Prophet ﷺ. Abu Lahab was the only one who broke this rule.

He was the Prophet's ﷺ next-door neighbour. He and his wife, Umm Jamil, made his life hard; she put thorns at his door at night. When the Prophet's ﷺ son died, Abu Lahab ran to tell the Quraysh with joy. At the markets, he followed the Prophet ﷺ, calling him a liar and throwing stones at him.
This is the only place in the Quran where an enemy of Islam is named. It showed everyone that in this religion, family ties give no special treatment.

The Prophet ﷺ climbed a mountain and called all the people of Quraysh. He asked: "If I told you an enemy would attack you tomorrow, would you believe me?" They said yes. He said: "Then I am warning you of a severe punishment." Abu Lahab shouted: "May you perish! Did you call us here for this?" Then this surah was revealed. (Al-Bukhari)
So the verse answers him: it is Abu Lahab who will perish.
His money and his children will not help him. Ibn Mas'ud reported that Abu Lahab said: "Even if my nephew is right, I will save myself on the Day of Judgement with my money and my children."
He will enter a Fire full of blazing flames.

His wife, Umm Jamil, supported him in his hostility. In the Fire, she will carry wood to make his punishment worse, with a rope of twisted fibre around her neck. Ibn Abbas and others said she used to put thorns in the Prophet's ﷺ path.
When this surah was revealed, she came angrily with a stone in her hand to look for the Prophet ﷺ. He was sitting with Abu Bakr, but Allah prevented her from seeing him. (Ibn Abi Hatim)

sections.title: Di mana dan kapan surah ini turun
paragraphs: Di Makkah, dan para ulama sepakat. Maududi berpendapat surah ini turun ketika permusuhan Abu Lahab sudah sangat parah, mungkin pada masa pemboikotan, ketika ia satu-satunya dari keluarga Nabi ﷺ yang memihak musuh melawan keluarganya sendiri.

sections.title: Siapakah Abu Lahab?
paragraphs: Ia adalah paman Nabi ﷺ sendiri. Di Arab, paman itu seperti ayah, dan keluarga selalu melindungi kerabatnya. Bahkan kerabat yang tidak beriman pun melindungi Nabi ﷺ. Abu Lahab satu-satunya yang melanggar aturan ini.

Ia tetangga dekat Nabi ﷺ. Ia dan istrinya, Ummu Jamil, menyusahkan hidup beliau; istrinya menaruh duri di depan pintu beliau pada malam hari. Ketika putra Nabi ﷺ wafat, Abu Lahab berlari dengan gembira memberitahu kaum Quraisy. Di pasar-pasar, ia mengikuti Nabi ﷺ, menyebut beliau pendusta, dan melempari beliau dengan batu.
Inilah satu-satunya tempat di Al-Qur'an yang menyebut nama musuh Islam. Ini menunjukkan kepada semua orang bahwa dalam agama ini, hubungan keluarga tidak memberi perlakuan istimewa.

Nabi ﷺ naik ke atas bukit dan memanggil semua orang Quraisy. Beliau bertanya, "Jika aku katakan bahwa musuh akan menyerang kalian besok, apakah kalian percaya?" Mereka menjawab ya. Beliau bersabda, "Maka aku memperingatkan kalian akan azab yang pedih." Abu Lahab berteriak, "Celakalah kamu! Apakah untuk ini kamu mengumpulkan kami?" Lalu turunlah surah ini. (HR. Al-Bukhari)
Maka ayat ini menjawabnya: justru Abu Lahab-lah yang celaka.
Harta dan anak-anaknya tidak akan menolongnya. Ibnu Mas'ud meriwayatkan bahwa Abu Lahab berkata, "Seandainya keponakanku benar, aku akan menebus diriku pada Hari Kiamat dengan harta dan anak-anakku."
Ia akan masuk ke dalam api yang bergejolak.

Istrinya, Ummu Jamil, mendukungnya dalam permusuhan itu. Di neraka, ia akan membawa kayu bakar untuk memperberat azab suaminya, dengan tali dari sabut yang dipintal di lehernya. Ibnu Abbas dan yang lain berkata bahwa ia dulu menaruh duri di jalan yang dilalui Nabi ﷺ.

Ketika surah ini turun, ia datang dengan marah membawa batu untuk mencari Nabi ﷺ. Beliau sedang duduk bersama Abu Bakar, tetapi Allah menghalanginya sehingga ia tidak bisa melihat beliau. (Riwayat Ibnu Abi Hatim)
